reason: Authenticated app-origin staging exists, but no running-stage cancellation route or client API exists. Stage action accepts only stage/discard; discard requires the slot lock and is not cancellation.
requestedSeam: POST /v1/stage/{job}/cancel; CompanionClient.CancelStageAsync(string jobId, CancellationToken ct = default); durable cancelled job, process-group/container cleanup, allocator release, no passing verdict
whyNot: No implemented cancellation endpoint to invoke; unnecessary app-origin full stage would not establish cancellation.
